response.justification: Bogdan has extensive (14+ years) full-stack experience spanning TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker/Kubernetes, and cloud-adjacent infrastructure, comfortably exceeding the 6+ years requirement. He has direct, current experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks (a required skill many candidates lack), plus a strong testing/craftsmanship background (built his own test runners and assertion libraries in D). His breadth across languages (TypeScript, Java, C#, DLang) and systems (web, embedded, mobile) demonstrates strong architecture and problem-solving ability, though Nest.js and Vitest specifically aren't explicitly listed on his resume.
strengths: Deep, current experience with AI agent development and MCP frameworks, directly matching a key required skill
Extensive full-stack TypeScript/Node.js/React experience across multiple senior roles (Optilyz, RIDE Capital, re:cinq)
Strong testing and software craftsmanship background, including building custom test runners/assertion libraries and applying TDD/CI/CD practices
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest specifically, despite general Node.js/testing experience
No mention of Kotlin or Python, and PostgreSQL not listed (only MongoDB/MySQL) among required DB/language skills
Early career shows many short (6-12 month) engagements, though this stabilized considerably in recent years
